name: @blockula/blackjack-xbot
description: The blackjack X bot, dry run only: parses commands from posts it is handed, plays the relayer path on a local chain, and writes its replies to files. It has no X client and posts nothing

scripts.test: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsx test/parse.ts && tsx test/copy.ts && tsx test/store.ts && tsx test/limits.ts && tsx test/links.ts && tsx test/bot.ts && tsx test/threads.ts && tsx test/no-x.ts
